propositions: The outbound comment differ computes its body-equality dedup key with different decoders on the local and Jira sides: local uses markdown round-trip normalization (which escapes markdown-active characters), while Jira side uses plain text decoding without escaping
Under rich_text_cutover=cloud, already-landed markdown comments within length limits fail to match their own bodies in the differ, causing duplicate mutation emissions
The send path encodes a decorated comment body, but the local dedup key derives from the undecorated body, causing the local markdown round-trip to diverge from the actual wire content
The fix derives the local dedup key by predicting the exact wire the send path produces and decoding it through the same _normalize_comment_body function used on the Jira side

The root cause was introduced in commit 27b868ba55 when the send path moved to codec ADF encoding of the decorated body while the local key routing flipped to flag-governed normalize_outbound, creating decoder asymmetry
